title: Create a new pricing configuration rule
gherkin:
Feature: Pricing Configuration Rule Management
  Scenario: Create a new pricing configuration rule
    Given the pricing configuration system is available
    When a user creates a new pricing rule with valid parameters
    Then the pricing rule should be successfully created
    And the rule should be stored in the system
rationale: Validates that pricing configuration rules can be created with proper parameters and persisted in the system.
generationSummary: Pricing configuration rule - Test cases for validating pricing configuration functionality including rule creation, validation, application, and management.

title: Apply pricing configuration rule to products
gherkin:
Feature: Pricing Configuration Rule Application
  Scenario: Apply pricing configuration rule to products
    Given a pricing configuration rule exists
    When the rule is applied to a product
    Then the product pricing should be updated according to the rule
    And the change should be reflected in the system
rationale: Ensures that pricing configuration rules can be applied to products and that pricing updates are correctly reflected.
generationSummary: Pricing configuration rule - Test cases for validating pricing configuration functionality including rule creation, validation, application, and management.

title: Validate pricing configuration rule parameters
gherkin:
Feature: Pricing Configuration Rule Validation
  Scenario: Validate pricing configuration rule parameters
    Given a pricing configuration rule is being created
    When the rule parameters are validated
    Then invalid parameters should be rejected
    And valid parameters should be accepted
rationale: Confirms that pricing configuration rules validate input parameters correctly before creation.

title: Update an existing pricing configuration rule

Feature: Pricing Configuration Rule Updates

    Given a pricing configuration rule exists in the system
    When a user modifies the rule parameters
    Then the rule should be updated with new values

title: Delete a pricing configuration rule

    When a user deletes the rule
    Then the rule should be removed from the system
    And products should no longer be affected by the deleted rule
